description: One Belgian annual-account deposit as filed (NBB CBSO Authentic Data): Belgian company financial statements as the official PDF, returned base64-encoded (structured JSON is not served yet). Reference comes from list_belgian_company_filings. Deposits are immutable. Paid via x402 ($0.15 in USDC or EURC).

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) to pay with prepaid credits instead of x402, with no wallet needed. Get one at https://api.sirenic.eu/compte?utm_source=api&utm_campaign=mcp. Ignored when x_payment is provided (the signed payment wins). On insufficient balance the tool returns a credits error, not an x402 quote.

reference.description: Deposit reference taken from the filings list, e.g. 2026-00123205

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive the payment quote.

name: get_belgian_company_filing
title: Belgian annual accounts (NBB)
